raw_response:
This plot is small, only 0.06 hectares, and I grow mixed crops on it intercropped together. I will put manure and compost on it because I have that from my animals, but I won't buy chemical fertilizer for this plot — I save the DAP and urea I get from the cooperative for my larger fields. I use my own saved seed, not the expensive improved seed from the market. No chemicals or irrigation — we depend on the rains here in Oromia. My family will work this plot ourselves; it is too small to hire anyone.
